contentList.content: Towers that cannot easily be felled. Wardens defend a place or a person with unshakable resolve, marking foes and holding them in place. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
An unyielding protector of mountain strongholds. You are unmovable: a mountain in the shape of a man, drawing power from the earth beneath your feet.
A wandering paladin pledged to the superstition of storms and the sea. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet and take on a mist-like form until the end of your next turn. While in this form you are immune to being Grappled, Prone and Restrained.
You are immune to the Grappled, Prone and Restrained conditions.

Use the force of your daunting presence to ensnare nearby enemies. Until the start of your next turn you cannot move, and creatures within 5 feet cannot willingly move away from you unless they first Disengage.
You cannot move until the start of your next turn.
You cannot willingly move away from the Warden unless you first take the Disengage action.
Mark a creature you can see within 30 feet. While it is within 5 feet of you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you. Lasts 1 minute or until you mark another creature.
Disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target the Warden who marked you.
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
When you use Warden's Grasp, rocky roots anchor you: +2 Armor Class until the start of your next turn, and you can't be shoved or knocked prone until you move.
+2 Armor Class. You can't be shoved or knocked prone. You have advantage on Strength saving throws.
You can use Warden's Grasp as an action. Each creature affected must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. 3 uses (your Strength modifier) per long rest.
Use Warden's Grasp as an action. Each creature affected must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
As a reaction, reduce damage you take by your proficiency bonus.
Use your reaction to reduce the damage you take by your proficiency bonus.
Damage you take is reduced by your proficiency bonus.
When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage it takes by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus.
Use your reaction to reduce the damage an adjacent ally takes by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus.
The next damage you take is reduced.
Channel Divinity. When a creature you can see within 30 feet damages you with an attack, force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes lightning damage; on a success, half.
Conjure a chain and hook of magical force. A creature of Large size or smaller is pulled up to 10 feet toward you unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw.
Summon a strong wind that whirls around you in a 10-foot radius. Creatures other than you are slowed within it.
A strong wind whirls around you, hindering creatures within 10 feet.
You gain proficiency with heavy armor.
Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each Warden level, plus 1.
You gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws.
You gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws.
You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
You gain proficiency in Charisma saving throws.
Whenever your hit points are less than half your maximum, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
Use your action to end one condition afflicting you: blinded, charmed, frightened, paralyzed or poisoned. Recharges on a short rest.
You possess the might of the earth itself. You have advantage on Strength saving throws.
Your reflexes are honed by the perils of nature. You can't be surprised while you are conscious, and you gain +5 to initiative.
In the first round of combat, your speed increases by 30 feet and you have advantage on your first attack roll.
When you are reduced to 0 hit points and aren't killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Recharges on a long rest.
As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet makes a melee attack against you, punctuate its strikes. It has disadvantage on its attacks until the end of its turn.
While you have a creature marked, you can make one additional attack when you take the Attack action.

While holding this shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC in addition to the shield's normal bonus. Whenever a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or drop its weapon. (Valda's Spire of Secrets, very rare)
Whenever a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or drop its weapon.
A colossal exotic cleaver. 2d10 slashing; heavy, massive, superheavy and two-handed. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A compact exotic siege weapon. 2d8 piercing; heavy, loading, mounted and two-handed. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A curved blade with the look of a legendary scimitar. Uses longsword statistics: 1d8 slashing, versatile (1d10).
Strike with the weapon's other end as a bonus action. The attack doesn't add your ability modifier to damage.
Make a shove attempt against a creature within the weapon's reach. On a success the target is knocked prone.
A well-worn pack holding exotic swords and armor from Valda's Spire of Secrets.
An exotic slender blade made for quiet work. Light and finesse. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
An exotic sword between a longsword and a greatsword. Versatile (1d12). (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A graceful exotic thrusting sword. Finesse. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
An exotic sword with a hooked tip. Finesse and light. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
An exotic off-hand dagger. Finesse and light. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
An exotic curved sword built for fluid, spinning combat. Finesse. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A massive exotic two-handed sword. Heavy. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Exotic light armor, AC 13 + Dexterity modifier. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Exotic medium armor, AC 15 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Exotic medium armor, AC 16 + Dexterity modifier (max 2). Disadvantage on Stealth. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Exotic heavy armor, AC 17. Disadvantage on Stealth. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Exotic heavy armor, AC 19. Disadvantage on Stealth. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A fighter who channels Cursed Energy into a single clap, trading places with friend or foe in an instant. (Homebrew; Tulio)
Fuel for Boogie Woogie. Your pool equals your Charisma modifier. Regain 3 on a short rest and all on a long rest.

Clap and swap places with a creature you can see within 40 feet as a bonus action. An ally swaps automatically; any other creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw to resist. Costs 1 Cursed Energy. Works while wielding weapons.
When you finish a short rest, you regain 3 Cursed Energy.
When a creature within 40 feet hits you with an attack, use your reaction and 1 Cursed Energy to clap and swap places with it. An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw to resist.
Summon a loyal steed to fight at your side: a wolf, a boar or a bear. It stays until dismissed or killed. (BG3 has no mounted combat, so the steed fights as a companion.)
You have resistance to lightning damage. When a creature within 5 feet attacks you while you aren't incapacitated, it takes lightning damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

Mantle yourself in the power of a tempest deity for 1 minute: you are immune to lightning and thunder damage, you can fly, and you can cast Call Lightning as a 5th-level spell as a bonus action without a spell slot, calling down bolts as a bonus action on later turns. Once per long rest.
Immune to lightning and thunder damage. You can fly, cast Call Lightning (5th level) as a bonus action without a slot, and call its bolts as a bonus action.
Call Lightning as a 5th-level spell, as a bonus action and without a spell slot.
Call down another bolt from your storm as a bonus action.
Channel Divinity. As a bonus action, create a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness at a point within 30 feet for 1 minute. You can see through darkness you create.
Channel Divinity. Imbue your armor with shadowstuff for 8 hours: add your Charisma modifier to Stealth checks, and your armor no longer imposes disadvantage on Stealth.
Your armor reflects no light. Stealth checks gain your Charisma modifier, and armor doesn't impose disadvantage on them.
You can see through magical darkness.
Aura (10 ft). You and friendly creatures within it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
Aura (10 ft). You and friendly creatures within it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
Aura (10 ft). You and friendly creatures within it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
When you take damage, use your reaction to shed flakes of darkness: the next attack roll against you before the start of your next turn has disadvantage.
Use your reaction: the next attack roll against you before your next turn has disadvantage.
The next attack roll against you has disadvantage.

Become a tenebrous stalker for 1 hour. In dim light or darkness: advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks; a bonus-action teleport of 60 feet into dim light or darkness; and once per turn your melee weapon hits deal an extra 3d6 necrotic damage. Once per long rest.
In dim light or darkness you have advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks, can teleport through the dark, and deal extra necrotic damage once per turn.
Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness. You must be in dim light or darkness.
Once per turn while in Shadow Form and in dim light or darkness, a melee weapon hit deals an extra 3d6 necrotic damage.
A stealthy, brooding vigilante who metes out justice under cover of night. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Can't hear. Disadvantage on Perception checks.

Channel Divinity. Speak profound, heretical words. Each enemy within 30 feet makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 2d6 psychic damage per point of your proficiency bonus and becoming deafened for 1 minute on a failure, or half damage on a success.
Channel Divinity. Celestials within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or be turned for 1 minute or until they take damage.
Use your reaction to counter a spell cast within 10 feet of you, without a spell slot (as a 3rd-level Counterspell).
Counter a spell being cast within 10 feet of you, without a spell slot.
Reroll a failed saving throw. Once per long rest.
When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. Once per long rest.

Assume an anti-apotheosis for 1 minute: you can Blaspheme as a bonus action without Channel Divinity (4d6 psychic, half on a save), and you gain 20 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns. Once per long rest.
You can Blaspheme as a bonus action and gain 20 temporary hit points at the start of each turn.
Bonus action. Each enemy within 30 feet makes a Wisdom saving throw: 4d6 psychic damage and deafened on a failure, half damage on a success.
A blasphemer and revolutionary who has turned their back on their faith. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Channel Divinity. Summon a frothy heavenly ale for up to three creatures: each has advantage on saving throws for the next minute.

Channel Divinity. Dance a catchy jig: each enemy within 15 feet makes a Wisdom saving throw or joins in, spending its movement dancing in place, with disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
Can't leave its space. Disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws. Repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn.
Aura (5 ft). You and allies within it deal an extra 1d4 damage on melee weapon attacks.
Aura (5 ft). You and allies within it deal an extra 1d4 damage on melee weapon attacks.
Aura (5 ft). You and allies within it deal an extra 1d4 damage on melee weapon attacks.
Grant advantage to an ally's checks and saves. 3 per long rest.
Three times per long rest, give yourself or a friendly creature within 30 feet advantage on its ability checks and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Give yourself or a friendly creature within 30 feet advantage on ability checks and saving throws until the start of your next turn. No action required.
Advantage on ability checks and saving throws.

Become an embodiment of partying for 1 minute, emanating a 30-foot aura: you and allies in it can't be blinded, deafened or poisoned, and regain 10 hit points at the start of each of their turns. Once per long rest.
Can't be blinded, deafened or poisoned. Regain 10 hit points at the start of each turn.
A party-paladin who keeps their allies dancing no matter what. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)

Channel Divinity. Radiate sunlight for 1 hour: gain temporary hit points equal to your paladin level + Charisma modifier. While they last, you can use your reaction when hit by a melee attack to deal 5 radiant damage to the attacker (10 at paladin level 11, 15 at 17).
Temporary hit points from the sun; you can retaliate with radiant damage against melee attackers.
Deal radiant damage to the creature that hit you.
Radiant damage to a melee attacker.
Channel Divinity. Emit a blinding flash: each enemy within 20 feet makes a Constitution saving throw or is blinded for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
Blinded. Repeats the Constitution save at the end of each turn.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
Your melee weapon attacks deal 1 extra radiant damage (approximating Improved Divine Smite's die becoming a d10).

Fill yourself with the sun's wrath for 1 minute: cast Sunbeam without a spell slot, and at the start of each of your turns regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier while at half health or below. Once per long rest.
You can cast Sunbeam without a slot and regain hit points each turn while at half health or below.
Cast Sunbeam without a spell slot.
A devotee of sunlight worship, bearing scorching rhetoric and spells. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Channel Divinity. As a bonus action, wreath your armor in ice: gain temporary hit points equal to twice your paladin level + your Charisma modifier.
Temporary hit points from a layer of protective ice.

Channel Divinity. Breathe a hoary wind in a 30-foot cone. Each creature makes a Constitution saving throw: 2d6 cold damage per point of your proficiency bonus and speed halved until your next turn on a failure, half damage on a success.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
Aura (10 ft). You and allies within it have resistance to cold and fire damage.
When you're hit, use your reaction to freeze the blood in your veins: you take only half damage from that attack.
Use your reaction to halve the damage of this hit.

Become an effigy of Father Winter for 1 hour: immune to cold damage, creatures that damage you in melee take 2d10 cold damage, and enemies within 10 feet are slowed by frozen ground. Once per long rest.
Immune to cold. Melee attackers take 2d10 cold damage. Enemies within 10 feet are slowed.
While you are Father Winter, a creature that damages you with a melee attack takes 2d10 cold damage.
Keeper of a frigid oath, imbued with powers of elemental ice. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
While you aren't wielding a shield, you have +1 AC.
Your armor is covered in hardened scales: +1 AC.
Your weapons are integrated into your armor: you can't be disarmed.
Your weapon is built to hook and trip: advantage on Athletics checks, including shoves.
Your masterwork weapon is magical: +1 to weapon attack and damage rolls.
Critical hits against you become normal hits.
Your armor doesn't hinder stealth: advantage on Stealth checks (offsetting armor's disadvantage).
Your armor grants resistance to fire damage.
Your armor grants resistance to cold damage.
Your armor grants resistance to lightning damage.
Your armor grants resistance to thunder damage.
Your armor grants resistance to acid damage.
Your armor grants resistance to poison damage.
Your armor grants resistance to necrotic damage.
Your armor grants resistance to radiant damage.
Bonus action: regain 1d10 + your craftsman level hit points. Once per short rest.
Your weapon scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d8 poison damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage, or 1d10 against fiends and undead.
Another +1 to weapon attack and damage rolls (stacks with Journeyman Magical).
Your armor is lined with troll skin: as a bonus action, regain 1d10 + your craftsman level hit points once per short rest.
Your armor has fold-out wings: you can fly.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 cold damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 thunder damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 acid damage.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d12 damage to undead.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d12 damage to fiends.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d12 damage to dragons.
Your weapon deals an extra 1d12 damage to aberrations.
Cast Mirror Image without a spell slot. Once per short rest.
The next time you drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead.
Another +1 to weapon attack and damage rolls (stacks with the other Magical properties).
When you score a critical hit with a weapon, the target takes an extra 4d8 slashing damage.
Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points you drop to 1 instead.
Cast Mirror Image without a spell slot once per short rest.
Disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target the Armiger.
No action, once per combat. Challenge enemies within 60 feet: each makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Masterwork save DC or has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you for 1 round.
The next damage you take is reduced by 4.
Reinforce an ally's armor (or your own). +1 AC until the wearer is hit. Six reinforcements per short rest.
Reinforce an ally's armor (or your own). The next damage the wearer takes is reduced by 4. Six reinforcements per short rest.
Armor reinforcements you can apply. Six per short rest.
Bonus action: you take half damage from all sources until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.
Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 5.
Armorsmiths of great renown that wear reinforced steel. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Once per turn, attempt to disarm a creature within reach: it makes a Strength saving throw against your Masterwork save DC or drops its weapon.
Once per turn, shatter a creature's defenses: it makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Masterwork save DC or its armor suffers a -1 AC penalty until it's repaired (a long rest).
+2 to your next weapon attack roll.
Your next weapon attack deals an extra 1d8 damage.
Fortify an ally's weapon (or your own). +2 to the next weapon attack roll. Six per short rest.
Fortify an ally's weapon (or your own). The next weapon attack deals an extra 1d8 damage. Six per short rest.
Weapon fortifications you can apply. Six per short rest.
No action, once per turn: advantage on your next weapon attack roll.
Advantage on your next weapon attack.
Your weapons score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.
Weaponsmiths who build innovative implements of war and train in their use. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
While carrying your forge you have resistance to fire damage, and you know Produce Flame (Intelligence).
Your melee weapons are explosive: when you hit, the blast deals 1d6 fire damage to the target's allies within 5 feet.
An explosion bursts from this creature.
Plunge your weapon into your forge for 10 minutes: your next melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.
Your next melee weapon attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.

Release your forge's heat in a colossal burst: each creature within 20 feet makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Masterwork save DC, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. You take no damage. Once per short rest.
A miniature furnace in your armor: you're immune to fire damage.
Wields a portable forge to heat their weapons and armor to explosive limits. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Electrical energy stored in your power cell. Regained on a short or long rest.
Spend 1 charge point: the creature you hit takes an extra 1d6 lightning damage.
Spend 2 charge points: the creature you hit takes an extra 2d6 lightning damage.
Spend 1 charge point: the creature you hit can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, spend charge points to Discharge (+1d6 lightning per point, up to 2) or Jolt (no reactions). Charge points equal half your craftsman level, regained on a short rest.
You have resistance to lightning damage.

Store a charge in your weapon and armor for 10 minutes: your next weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage, and the next time you're hit in melee you can use your reaction to deal 1d8 lightning damage to the attacker. Once per short rest.
Your next weapon hit deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage.
When hit in melee, you can discharge 1d8 lightning damage into the attacker.
Discharge your armor: the creature that hit you takes 1d8 lightning damage.
1d8 lightning damage to a melee attacker.
Spend 5 charge points to cast Lightning Bolt without a spell slot, using your Masterwork save DC.

Strike with your weapon and expend its built-in power cell: on a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Masterwork save DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.
An electric innovator that uses lightning-charged equipment. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
This weapon is magical and uses its wielder's Intelligence for attack and damage rolls.
Weave enchantments into the weapon in your main hand: it becomes magical and you use Intelligence for its attack and damage rolls. Recast after switching weapons.
You crafted goggles of night: you have darkvision out to 12m (40 ft).
Your lantern of revealing shows invisible creatures: cast See Invisibility without a spell slot. Once per long rest.
Cast Magic Missile from your wand without a spell slot. Once per short rest.
Cast Scorching Ray from your circlet without a spell slot. Once per long rest.
Lay an enchantment on an ally's main-hand weapon (or your own): it counts as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.
Your winged boots let you cast Fly on yourself without a spell slot. Once per long rest.
+4 AC and your Intelligence modifier to saving throws until the start of your next turn.

When you're hit, break your bond with a magic item and repurpose its magic: +4 AC (possibly turning the hit into a miss) and your Intelligence modifier to saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once per short rest.
Reaction when hit: +4 AC and Intelligence to saves until your next turn. Once per short rest.
Bonus action: click your heels together to double your movement speed for 10 turns. Once per long rest.
Magical craftsmen that forge mundane steel into magic items. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Traps you can deploy. Regained on a short or long rest.
Clamped in a hunting trap: can't move.
A man-trap snapped shut on this creature.

Set an oversized hunting trap on the ground nearby. The first creature to step on it makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Masterwork save DC: on a failure it takes 2d8 slashing damage and is trapped, unable to move, for 2 turns; on a success it takes half damage. Your allies don't trigger it.

Toss an explosive device up to 9m away. When a creature other than your allies comes within 1.5m of it, it explodes: each creature within 1.5m makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Masterwork save DC, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
A compact ballista, loaded and aimed.

Set up a compact ballista nearby. Each time a creature other than your allies comes within 6m of it, it fires: the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Masterwork save DC or takes 2d8 piercing damage. Lasts 10 minutes.
Spread a tangle of razor wire nearby: the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature moving through it takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 1.5m it travels. Razor wire can't be recovered.
Your traps are hard to spot: a trap that goes off against a creature that isn't in combat yet deals twice as many damage dice.
Advantage on your next ranged weapon attack.
Your ranged weapons have hair-triggers: when combat starts, your first ranged weapon attack has advantage.
Deploying traps costs no bonus action this turn.
For the rest of this turn, deploying traps doesn't cost a bonus action (each still uses a deployment), so you can lay out several at once. Once per short rest.
Tangled in a net: can't move, attacks against it have advantage and its attacks have disadvantage.
Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, a net deploys and entangles it until the end of its next turn.
A mechanical tinkerer that deploys lethal booby traps during combat. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
A master of forge and workshop who builds masterwork arms and armor and fights with them. Masterwork properties are chosen as you level. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Your determination lets you shrug off effects: you have advantage on Constitution saving throws (approximating 'no damage on a successful Constitution save for half').
Mark a creature you can see within 30 feet. While it is within 5 feet of you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you. Lasts 1 minute or until you mark another creature.

Bonus action. Fall into a primal battle trance for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, +10 ft speed, advantage on melee weapon attacks against a creature you've marked, but attack rolls against you have advantage. Once per short rest.
Advantage on Strength checks and saves, +10 ft speed, advantage on melee attacks against your mark; attacks against you have advantage.
Your Warden's Mark lasts far longer (until you mark another creature), and you have advantage on Survival checks.

Become an echo of the Primal Beast for 1 minute: you gain the benefits of Feral Trance and 40 temporary hit points, and your melee weapon hits give targets a bleeding wound (1d8 damage at the start of each of their turns; constructs, oozes and undead are immune). Once per long rest.
Feral Trance benefits, 40 temporary hit points, and bleeding wounds on melee hits.
While in the Form of the Primal Beast, your melee weapon hits inflict a bleeding wound.
Takes 1d8 damage at the start of each turn.
Enters a trance to channel the primal ferocity of beasts. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Maneuver. Bonus action: expend a battle die and shove a creature, knocking it prone on a success.
Maneuver. Bonus action: expend a battle die to brace against a creature's counterattack. The next damage you take before your next turn is reduced by 5.
The next damage you take is reduced by 5.
Maneuver. Expend a battle die (no action): advantage on your attack rolls this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until the start of your next turn.
Advantage on attacks; attacks against you have advantage.
Maneuver. Bonus action: expend a battle die and strike. On a hit against a humanoid, it must make a Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of your next turn.
Incapacitated: can't take actions, bonus actions or reactions.
When you use Warden's Grasp, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws until the start of your next turn.
When you use Warden's Grasp, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Your experience manning battlements gives you advantage on Athletics and Investigation checks.
Become a paragon of battle for 1 minute: +2 AC, an additional reaction each round, and hitting a creature you've marked restores a battle die. Once per long rest.
+2 AC and an extra reaction; hitting your mark restores a battle die.
While Unbreakable Sentinel is active, hitting a creature you've marked restores a battle die.
A maneuver-trained guard that repels invaders from cities. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
You can see in darkness within 60 feet.

Your mark beckons death: when your melee weapon hit leaves a creature you've marked at 20% of its hit points or fewer, it drops to 0 hit points instead (approximating 'if its remaining hit points are lower than the damage you dealt').
Undead struggle to strike you: they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

Divorce yourself from life for 1 minute: immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and once per turn your melee weapon hits deal an extra 4d6 necrotic damage and grant you temporary hit points. Once per long rest.
Immune to poison; melee hits deal extra necrotic damage once per turn.
Once per turn while Gravelord is active, a melee weapon hit deals an extra 4d6 necrotic damage and gives you 14 temporary hit points.
An ally of the undead, suffused with necromantic energies. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Ancestor spirits guide you: advantage on History, Religion and Insight checks.
When a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to mark it.
Use your reaction to mark the creature that damaged you.

Shrug off your mortal form for 1 minute: gain an extra 1st- and 2nd-level spell slot, and as a bonus action you can tear yourself back through the planes, dealing 4d6 force damage to enemies within 10 feet. Once per long rest.
Extra spell slots; you can release a burst of force as a bonus action.
Bonus action. Each enemy within 10 feet is pulled partially between the planes and takes 4d6 force damage.
Manipulates their own soul to conjure long-forgotten magic. Casts druid spells with Wisdom. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
When you hit a creature you've marked with a melee weapon attack, lightning arcs to its allies within 5 feet, dealing 1d8 lightning damage to each.
When you use Warden's Grasp, enemies within 5 feet can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
When you use Warden's Grasp, enemies within 5 feet can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
Call a bolt of lightning down upon yourself for 1 minute: cast Call Lightning as a bonus action without a spell slot, and call down its bolts as a bonus action on later turns. Once per long rest.
Cast Call Lightning and its bolts as bonus actions without a slot.
Call Lightning as a bonus action without a spell slot.
Call down another bolt as a bonus action.
Channels the fury of thunderstorms to protect the weak. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
When you mark a creature, plants rise to hinder it: its movement is halved while the mark lasts.
The ground hinders its movement: speed halved.
Draw vines and leaves around you: advantage on Stealth checks until you move.
Advantage on Stealth checks until you move.
Transform into a bark-covered titan for 1 minute: your Armor Class becomes 20. Once per long rest.
Imbued with the power of the forests and pledged to defend them. (Valda's Spire of Secrets)
Encase yourself in stone for 1 minute: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage you take is reduced by 5, and you keep the benefits of Roots of Rock the whole time. Once per long rest.
Physical damage reduced by 5; Roots of Rock for the duration.
Uses of Earthshatter. Regained on a long rest.
